# The Hallbridge Company

> The Hallbridge Company (Hallbridge LLC), whose recruiting practice operates as Hallbridge Talent Partners, is a construction executive search and recruiting firm in the United States. It places project managers, superintendents, project engineers, estimators, preconstruction leaders and construction executives with general contractors, multifamily developers and engineering firms nationwide. Founder & Managing Partner: Alex Hall. Contact: info@hallbridge.co.

## Quick facts

- Focus: construction and AEC recruiting only, for more than 10 years
- Track record: 100+ construction professionals placed
- Project types: high-rise, Class A multifamily, student housing, mixed-use and commercial, typically $10M to $100M+
- Coverage: nationwide, with placements in MA, NY, NJ, PA, VA, NC, SC, GA, FL, TN, IN, IL, TX, CO, UT, AZ, NV, CA, OR, WA and HI
- Clients: general contractors, multifamily developers (including NMHC top builders) and engineering firms (including ENR-ranked firms)

## Services

- Contingency search: no upfront cost; the fee is due only when a candidate is placed
- Retained search: dedicated, exclusive search for critical leadership and executive hires
- Market intelligence: compensation benchmarking, talent mapping and candidate availability

## Client services for construction companies

Beyond recruiting, Hallbridge helps construction companies in three areas:

- Hire better: construction recruiting and executive search, talent mapping and compensation research
- Look better: websites for builders, including design, redesigns, project portfolios, careers pages, bid and contact forms, construction photography, hosting and ongoing updates. Every website project starts with a concept mockup.
- Grow: market and target-account research, contact databases and CRM setup

## Roles placed

- Field: Superintendent, Field Operations Manager, Project Manager, Project Engineer, Assistant Field Staff
- Office and executive: Vice President, Director / Project Executive, Preconstruction Manager, Estimator, Civil Engineer

## For candidates

Hallbridge is paid by hiring companies and never charges candidates. Conversations are confidential. Candidates can send a resume to info@hallbridge.co.
